name: SlateCommandReceipt
description: A record that one critical command has already been applied. A retried request finds its receipt and is handed the original result instead of being applied a second time, so a dropped connection can never charge twice or hand over two of the same thing.

save_id.description: The universe the command was applied to.

idempotency_key.description: Client-generated, unique per intended action. The same key is always the same action, never a second one.

command_kind.description: Which command this receipt is for, e.g. veh.purchase.

result.description: What the command returned the first time, replayed verbatim on a retry.
